_readme: Spec for the master 'Report Page' page_template row (npmrdsv5+npmrds_sub|page_template, id 2187021) — the template every report starts from via '+ Add Page → Your Templates' / '+ Create Report'. Built by report_page_template_build.mjs. Only the editorial fields an author would actually want to change live here; the ReportRouteList sidebar's join/externalSource plumbing is 100% invariant and lives in report_page_route_list_element_data.json instead, not because it's secret but because no one edits it by hand and it doesn't belong in a reviewable-copy diff. See planning/transportny/tasks/current/report-page-template-editorial-slots.md for the template's change history.
